dialogue.conversations.pastimes: How do you pass the time?
dialogue.pastimes.cat: Time off, is it? Go on.
dialogue.pastimes.cat.music: Is there music in this village?
dialogue.pastimes.music.respond: That's the music, such as it is.
dialogue.pastimes.music.respond.praise: A village sounds better with music in it.
dialogue.pastimes.music.respond.leave: I'll let you get back to it.
dialogue.pastimes.games.respond: That's how we fill an evening.
dialogue.pastimes.close: Anyway. That's how it goes here.
dialogue.pastimes.close.agree: That's a good way to spend an evening.
dialogue.pastimes.close.share: I do the same when I get the chance.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.open/1: There's a fiddle in this village and it comes out most evenings. I'd not sleep as well without it.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.open/2: We sing when the harvest is in. It isn't good singing, but it's loud and everybody knows the words.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.open/3: Somebody plays a drum three doors down. I stopped minding it and started listening for it.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.again/1: We have been over the music today, %1$s. It hasn't changed key since.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.again/2: Same tunes as when you asked this morning. Same opinion of them, too.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.again/3: You're keen on this subject. Fine, but there's nothing new to report.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.ask_more/: Two or three of us, badly, and one who is genuinely good and won't admit it.
Anyone with an instrument and no shame. That's about four people.
Fewer than there used to be. The good one moved on and the rest of us kept going.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.praise/1: It does. A quiet village is usually a village where something has gone wrong.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.praise/2: That's my view too. Costs nothing and it holds the place together.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.praise/3: It does, though try telling that to whoever is trying to sleep.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.leave/1: Go on, then. There'll be music later either way.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.leave/2: Fine. I've work that won't do itself, %1$s.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.music.leave/3: Off with you. Ask me again some evening.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.open/1: There's a board game with carved pieces that gets passed around. I lose at it regularly.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.open/2: We race to the far fence and back. I'm not the fastest, but I'm not last either.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.open/3: Somebody hides and everybody else looks. It works better when it isn't raining.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.again/1: You asked already. We still play, and I still lose about half.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.again/2: Nothing has changed since this morning, %1$s. Same game, same people.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.again/3: Twice now. Are you after an invitation, or just checking?
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.ask_more/: Most days once the work is done. Less in winter, when it's dark by the time we're free.
Often enough that I've a favourite spot and a bad habit of guarding it.
Whenever there are enough of us. Two isn't enough for anything good.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.challenge: You'd back yourself. Everyone does, right up until they've played.
That's a fine thing to say to somebody who practises. Come along and find out.
Ha. I'll take that. Bring somebody to keep score, though.
Would you. It isn't a contest, it's how we get through the evening.
Maybe. I'd rather play than argue about who would win.
If you like. I don't keep score in my head the way some do.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.games.leave/2: Go on. We start about dusk if you change your mind.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.agree/1: It is. Better than sitting looking at the wall, which is the alternative.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.agree/2: That's about the size of it. There isn't much else on offer after dark.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.agree/3: It is, and I'd not swap it for anything grander either.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.share/1: Then you should come by. We're not fussy about who joins in.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.share/2: Good. Everybody needs one thing that isn't work.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.share/3: That's worth hearing. Half the people passing through don't stop for anything.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.leave/1: Off you go. I'll be here.
dialogue.sample_pastimes.close.leave/2: Fair enough, %1$s. Come by when there's a game on.
